# White & Black

> Creative agency and print partner in Trichy (Tiruchirappalli), Tamil Nadu, India, since 2006. Logo design and brand identity, packaging design and printing, business cards and stationery, brochures and catalogues, hoardings and outdoor advertising, and social media marketing for brands across Tamil Nadu.

- Address: D46A, ABC Lotus Arcade, 6th Cross, Thillai Nagar East Extension, Trichy 620018, Tamil Nadu, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98423 55203
- Email: mail@whiteandblack.in
- Founded: 2006 · Team: 25 · Founders: V Arunkumar (Visualizer), KP Balaji (Head – Strategy & Finance)

## Products
- [Packaging Design & Printing in Trichy](https://whiteandblack.in/packaging-design-printing-trichy/): Product packaging, boxes, labels and wrappers designed and printed in Trichy by White & Black — shelf-ready packaging for brands across Tamil Nadu since 2006.
- [Business Card Design & Printing in Trichy](https://whiteandblack.in/business-card-printing-trichy/): Visiting card and business card design and printing in Trichy — matte, gloss, kraft, rounded and foil finishes, plus letterheads and stationery by White & Black.
- [Brochure & Catalogue Design in Trichy](https://whiteandblack.in/brochure-catalogue-design-trichy/): Tri-fold brochures, product catalogues, flyers, menus, magazines and invitations designed and printed in Trichy by White & Black, creative agency since 2006.
- [Hoarding & Outdoor Advertising in Trichy](https://whiteandblack.in/hoarding-outdoor-advertising-trichy/): Hoardings, flex banners, standees, glow sign boards and shop branding designed in Trichy by White & Black — outdoor advertising that reads at a glance.
- [Logo Design & Brand Identity in Trichy](https://whiteandblack.in/logo-design-branding-trichy/): Logo design, brand identity and corporate identity in Trichy by White & Black — from first sketch to stationery, packaging and signage. Creative agency since 2006.
- [Social Media Design & Marketing in Trichy](https://whiteandblack.in/social-media-marketing-trichy/): Social media post design and digital marketing creatives in Trichy by White & Black — scroll-stopping posts, festive campaigns and ads that match your brand.
